automationComposer.anyExternalSystemWake: Any external system can wake this automation by POSTing this URL.
automationComposer.automationCreatedWireUp: Automation created: wire up the webhook:
automationComposer.visitorChatCreatedDrop: Visitor chat created: drop this into your site:
automationComposer.onAnyPageListed: on any page you listed above. The launcher appears in the corner; visitor conversations show up on your agents board, where you can watch and take over.

automationFields.aboutSecondEachVisitors: About a second of each visitor's browser time. No keys.
automationFields.afterEveryIsolatedAgent: After every isolated agent turn, including the ones that errored or conflicted.
automationFields.checkInboxSummarizeAnything: Check the inbox and summarize anything urgent.
automationFields.decidePerPersonWho: Decide per person who it answers
automationFields.decidePerPersonWho2: Decide per person who it answers, and as whom
automationFields.eachMessageRunsAgent: Each message runs an agent turn on your account. Blank means {webchat_daily_max_default} a day.
automationFields.holdMessagesRuleApproval: Hold messages from rule {index} for approval
automationFields.invisibleMostVisitorsNeeds: Invisible for most visitors. Needs a Cloudflare widget.
automationFields.modelAutomationChange: Model {index} for this automation: {label}. Change it
automationFields.n0FiresOnEvery: 0 fires on every occurrence. Short of the bar, a due run is recorded as skipped and says how far off it is.
automationFields.name: Name
automationFields.newSessionsRequiredSince: New sessions required since the last wake before a due run fires
automationFields.newSessionsRunSince: new sessions have run since it last woke
automationFields.onePerLineScheme: One per line, scheme and host only. www and the bare domain count separately.
automationFields.onlyAgentsWorkActually: Only when an agent's work actually reaches your workspace.
automationFields.onlyAllowedSitesDaily: Only the allowed sites and the daily limit are left.
automationFields.requireMyApprovalBefore2: Require my approval before it runs
automationFields.sStarterSendsDifferent: This is {label}'s starter, but {label2} sends a different payload.
automationFields.secondsToHoldEach: Seconds to hold each run before it starts
automationFields.shownInYourClock: Shown in your own clock; this schedule is set by {zone}.
automationFields.sitesOwnOauthClient: Your site's own OAuth client. Add each allowed site to it as an authorized origin.
automationFields.standard5FieldCron: Standard 5-field cron: minute hour day month weekday.
automationFields.staysInSandboxOnly: Stays in your sandbox: only the site key is ever sent to a visitor's browser.
automationFields.strangersWritePromptsSaving: Strangers write these prompts, so saving adds a read-only visitor chat to your personas.
automationFields.toolNamesCommaSeparated: Tool names, comma-separated. Empty leaves the persona's own list alone.
automationFields.toolNamesJobMay: Tool names this job may call
automationFields.visitorsGetNoAnswer: Visitors get no answer in the widget: approved replies land in your chat instead.
automationFields.whoRunsWhatPays: Who it runs as, and what pays for it.
automationFields.retiredNeverFires: Nothing sends this any more: the check that ran after every land is gone, so this automation never fires. Pick one of the moments above, or wake on a failed CI pipeline instead.

othersCaption.allow: Anyone not named is answered as the persona above, which is what this automation did before it had rules.
othersCaption.hold: Anyone not named waits in Approvals for you, and runs as the persona above once you say so.
othersCaption.ignore: Anyone not named gets no answer. They still show up under “seen recently”, so naming them later is a click.

kindCaption.event: When any outside system POSTs to its webhook URL, which is shown to you once it exists.
kindCaption.listener: The moment a connected service sends something. Nothing is polled: a gateway holds the connection open.
kindCaption.once: At one moment, on your own clock, and then it switches itself off. A sandbox that is asleep when the moment comes fires it as soon as it is back, saying how late it is.
kindCaption.schedule: On a clock, in this sandbox's own timezone.
kindCaption.source: The moment {source} sends one of these. Nothing is polled: a gateway holds the connection open.
kindCaption.visitorChat: When a visitor writes in the chat widget on your site: one conversation each, live for you to take over.
kindCaption.workspace: On a moment in this workspace's own work. No token and no URL: nothing outside the sandbox can fire it.

automationFields.noteHint: One line on what it is for. Its notifications lead with it.
automationFields.endsCaption: It switches itself off {when} and tells you.
automationFields.whatHasToBeTrue: What has to be true first. No model runs to check it.

conditionCaption.none: Nothing is checked: every fire goes ahead.
conditionCaption.guard: A shell command run in the workspace first. Exit 0 goes ahead, and what it prints goes with the wake; anything else is recorded as skipped. $AUTOMATION_STATE names a file it may keep between runs, and $AUTOMATION_LAST holds what it printed when it last passed.
conditionCaption.npm: A package on the npm registry, checked by the sandbox itself: no shell, no token.
conditionCaption.github: The newest release of a public GitHub repository, checked by the sandbox itself.
conditionCaption.url: One web page's text, or the part of it a pattern picks out.

automationFields.guardCommand: Command that decides whether it goes ahead

npmCaption.range: Passes once a published version satisfies the range; what it sees is that version.
npmCaption.tag: Sees the version under this tag, latest when blank. Pair it with “only a change” to hear about each new one.

automationFields.pageCaption: Blank watches the page's whole text. A regular expression narrows it to what it matches, its first group if it has one.
automationFields.checkNowHint: Runs the check once, now. Nothing is saved.
automationFields.checkWaiting: Not yet. It is still waiting:
automationFields.checkPassesFires: Passes now, so its next check fires it. It sees:
automationFields.checkPassesChange: It sees this now, and fires when that changes:

fireOnCaption.pass: Every check that passes sets it off.
fireOnCaption.change: Only when what the check sees differs from last time. The first check just notes where things stand.

targetCaption.agent: A new agent starts with the prompt below and what the check saw.
targetCaption.conversation: The conversation picks up where it stopped, told what the check saw and the prompt below. It runs on its own model.
targetCaption.notify: No model runs: your devices get a notification with what the check saw, or the words below when it saw nothing.

automationFields.notifyPlaceholder: The page you were watching changed.
automationFields.aiDisclosure: Tell visitors replies come from AI
automationFields.aiDisclosureDefault: Replies are written by an AI assistant and may contain mistakes.
automationFields.personaGoneHint: That persona no longer exists, so its wakes would run with no tools and no accounts. Pick another.

automationRow.noSitesAllowedNobody: no sites allowed: nobody can chat
automationRow.nothingYetRunNow: Nothing yet. Run now to try it.
automationRow.openTranscriptRun: Open the transcript of the run from {at}
automationRow.sureEverySenderWired: Sure? Every sender wired to this URL has to be handed the new one.
automationRow.urlShownToMaintainers: Its URL is shown to maintainers and the owner.
automationRow.turnstileUnfinished: Turnstile not finished: no bot check
automationRow.lastSawSince: What it saw last, unchanged since {when}
automationRow.personaMissingNote: {ids} no longer exists, so its wakes run with no tools and no accounts. Pick another persona.
automationRow.noAccountsNote: Its wakes have every tool but none of your signed-in accounts. Pick Full access or a persona if it has to post or browse as you.

automationsView.nothingRunsOnOwn: Nothing runs on its own yet.
automationsView.runHistoryCantUndone: and its run history? This can't be undone.
automationsView.takeOneOffersBelow: Take one of the offers below, or build your own with

microsoft365.mention: Only mail addressed directly to you (your address in To)
microsoft365.senderHint: The From address as Outlook delivered it; a display name is not checked.

visitorChatInstallDialog.noBrowserLoadedWidget: No browser has loaded this widget yet. Paste the snippet, open your site, and this updates on its own within a few seconds.
visitorChatInstallDialog.noSitesAllowed: No sites are allowed yet, so every visitor is turned away. Add one below or edit the automation.
visitorChatInstallDialog.pasteIntoSiteBefore: Paste this into your site, before

useCiDelivery.allPolled: Webhooks aren't set up, so pipelines are polled instead: this fires within {minutes} minutes rather than instantly.
useCiDelivery.firesWithinSecondsProvider: Fires within seconds, the provider delivers each finished pipeline straight to this sandbox.
useCiDelivery.namedRepoDoesNotMap: No repo named "{repo}" maps to a connected GitHub or GitLab account, so nothing can fire this.
useCiDelivery.noRepoMaps: No workspace repo maps to a connected GitHub or GitLab account, so nothing can fire this yet.
useCiDelivery.partlyPolled: Wired for {wired} of {total} repos. {names} is polled instead, those fire within {minutes} minutes. | Wired for {wired} of {total} repos. {names} are polled instead, those fire within {minutes} minutes.

useAutomationForm.addSite: Add at least one site: a Visitor chat with no allowed sites admits nobody.
useAutomationForm.emptyRule: Every rule needs at least one person or group; remove the empty one.
useAutomationForm.nameFormat: Use letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; must start with a letter or digit.
useAutomationForm.notAnOrigin: "{origin}" isn't an origin, use scheme + host only, e.g. https://example.com
useAutomationForm.pickDateTime: Pick the date and time it should fire.
useAutomationForm.pickModel: Pick at least one model: an automation runs while nobody is watching, so nothing is chosen for it.
useAutomationForm.guardRequired: Write the command, or pick another condition.
useAutomationForm.packageRequired: Name the package, like bun or {'@'}scope/name.
useAutomationForm.rangeRequired: Name a version range, like >=1.4.3, or follow a tag instead.
useAutomationForm.repoFormat: Name the repository as owner/name, like oven-sh/bun.
useAutomationForm.pageUrl: Give the page's full address, starting with http:// or https://.
useAutomationForm.pickEndDate: Pick the end date and time, or clear it.
useAutomationForm.endPassed: That end date has already passed.

calendar.nothingThisWeek: Nothing wakes on a clock this week.
calendar.clickToSet: Click any free time to set a one-time wake there.
calendar.elsewhere: {count} automation wakes on events, not on a clock. | {count} automations wake on events, not on a clock.

peek.guarded: Checks first, and wakes only if its check finds something.
peek.afterSessions: Skipped until {count} new session has run. | Skipped until {count} new sessions have run.

automationRail.howFiled: Filed by the group each one names, else by the persona it runs as.

automationDetail.failedInARow: Failed {count} time in a row | Failed {count} times in a row

automationLabels.groupHint: Automations in one group share a shelf. Blank files it by its persona.

builtInPersonas.fullAccessNote: every tool and every signed-in account

scheduleWords.everyHoursAt: Every hour at :{minute} | Every {count} hours at :{minute}
scheduleWords.everyHoursBetween: Every hour from {from} to {to} | Every {count} hours from {from} to {to}

scheduleProperty.afterSessions: Only once {count} new session has run | Only once {count} new sessions have run

gateProperty.askNote: Waits in Approvals until you say yes.
gateProperty.change: Change what happens before it runs: {now}
gateProperty.delayNote: Shows in Approvals for a while, then starts by itself.
gateProperty.label: Before it runs
gateProperty.onlyOnChange: Only when what it checks changes

groupProperty.hint: Leave blank to file it by its persona.

checkSection.hint: A shell command run first. Exit 0 goes ahead, anything else skips the run. Blank removes the check.
checkSection.keys: Enter saves, Esc puts it back.

service.authority: Authority: the steward’s access, narrowed by its profile. Personas only narrow this further.
